name: Careful
promptTemplate:
You are driving a small rover to its charger. The charger is a bright green disc on the floor with a thin green post standing in it. Orange, red, blue and purple boxes are obstacles, and the grey walls are the arena edge. Each turn rotates you 30 degrees; FORWARD moves one step. Camera view, looking straight ahead: {{frame}}. Your recent moves, oldest first: {{history}}.
Look at the image, then answer in exactly three lines:
TARGET: left, center, right or not visible (where the green post is, by thirds of the image)
BLOCKED: yes or no (is a box or wall close ahead in the lower middle of the image?)
MOVE: your move
Rules for MOVE, first match wins: if BLOCKED is yes, turn toward the side the target is on, or TURN_LEFT if it is center or not visible. If TARGET is not visible, TURN_LEFT. If TARGET is left, TURN_LEFT. If TARGET is right, TURN_RIGHT. If TARGET is center, FORWARD. If your last three moves alternate left and right turns, FORWARD instead. You reach the charger by driving onto it; never answer STOP.
The MOVE line must be exactly one of FORWARD, TURN_LEFT or TURN_RIGHT.
